caption: The drawing depicts a wooden corner cabinet with a light brown color and wood grain texture. The cabinet features a triangular form that allows it to fit into a corner, with a flat top and two visible sides that angle backward. The upper section consists of three shelves with curvilinear, cloud-like edges, separated by horizontal dividers. Below the shelves, there is a rectangular door with a recessed panel, adorned with simple molding. The door includes a small round knob on the left and two metal hinges on the right. The cabinet sits alone against a plain, off-white background, and the woodwork has been rendered with attention to natural variations in color and pattern.
title: Corner Cupboard
